continuityLaw: partition -> transform/exchange -> invariant carry -> scar carry -> recontextualize/rebase -> accuracy gate -> admit

principles.canonicalWorld: one canonical world, many lawful projections
principles.canonicalPhase: one canonical phase, many relative projections
principles.interactionRelativity: AI/tool/service handoff is a frame transform, not a context reset
principles.motionRelativity: returned work is reconciled against current canonical state, not blindly merged against departure state
principles.computeRelativity: working-set topology is relative to novelty, uncertainty, contradiction, proof urgency, motion, observer relevance, expected information gain and cost

lineageEnvelope.rule: handoffs append a child packet identity while retaining an explicit parent chain

serviceRoles.OMEGAv6: canonical state, admission, proof, replay and final operator surface
serviceRoles.Genesis: variation, proposal, exploration and branch generation
serviceRoles.SAI: learned cognition, memory, semantic interpretation, training and adaptation
serviceRoles.Optical: scalar screening, RCWA/FDTD/full-wave promotion and optical evidence
serviceRoles.Sovereign: private/native heavy execution, local tools, training and hardware receipts
serviceRoles.Earth: source-bound observation, trajectory, motion and world-state evidence
serviceRoles.Federation: typed exchange, routing, proof transport and continuity carry
serviceRoles.DriveArchive: donor genome and episodic history; never silent current authority

truthBoundary: R126 defines causal interaction, synchronization, frame transformation and reconciliation contracts. It does not by itself prove that any external site, PC, solver, sensor, model provider or deployment is live; those claims require first-hand runtime evidence.
